calculation.description: Ranks assets higher when their trailing 20-day return is more negative after scaling by trailing 20-day realized volatility. Cross-sectional winsorization limits outliers. The signal uses only information through date t and predicts the forward close-to-close return over 40 trading days.

metrics.ic_definition: mean daily cross-sectional Spearman IC against 40-trading-day forward returns

validation.regime_notes: Full-history admission passes the benchmark gates (absolute IC >= 0.0070 and absolute ICIR >= 0.0840). Performance is regime-dependent: early IC -0.027998 / ICIR -0.082749, mid IC -0.076437 / ICIR -0.219933, online IC 0.133708 / ICIR 0.473196, recent one-year IC 0.050049 / ICIR 0.178454. Interpret uncertainty conservatively given the 15-asset cross-section.
validation.signal_artifact_note: Artifact contains the factor signal values through validation date; filename retains the research-cycle 10d convention, while admission metrics use the 40-day horizon.
